title: Listening Drill — Introductory bike ride — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Introductory bike ride — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on introductory bike ride last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with soft tyre. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: loose valve.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of tyre pressure so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow spare tube instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the ride leader before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Thursday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
